answer: A sybil cluster must fund many independent stakes plus sustained work to close the reputation delta with honest nodes, making the cost scale superlinearly with identity count. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations across epochs. Only participants reaching the trust summit—sustained attestation over several epochs—earn governance weight, while new identities ride a thin zephyr of provisional influence until proven. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
